paragraphs: Mari bar Isak, before Rav Ḥisda, Bava Metzia 39b. There were two, Tosafot Yevamot 21b: one in Rav Ashi's days, as appears here and in Bava Metzia 22a, where Rav Ashi, Amemar and Mar Zutra visited Mari bar Isak's orchard. Another lived in Rav Ḥisda's days: Bava Metzia 39b, cited above, says Ḥana bar Isak—some say Mari bar Isak—had a brother arrive from Bei Ḥozai; he came before Rav Ḥisda. Rav Ḥisda died in Rava's days (see his entry), and Rav Ashi was born on the day Rava died. End of quotation.
